title: File:Palm Springs Band Lido Berlin 20080531.JPG
desc: Picture of the british band "Palm Springs" during their concert in the Berlin club Lido on May 31st, 2008. The concert took place to celebrate the 25th birthday of the Berlin based record store "Mr Dead and Mrs Free". The picture was taken with an iPhone.

title: File:Lido Nightclub Berlin.jpg
desc: Lido is one of Kreuzbergs most famous clubs for concerts and parties. I love the building itself and the buildings in the back of Lido. Especially i like the big grafiti at the top of the left building. ;)
